title: Binary-product and zero-morphism preservation imply additivity
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be preadditive categories [def-weil-preadditive-category], so that each morphism set is an abelian group and composition is bilinear. Assume $\mathcal C$ has binary products. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor preserving binary products and zero morphisms: $F(0_{M,N})=0_{FM,FN}$ for all $M,N$. Then $F$ is additive: for all $h,k:M\to N$, $F(h+k)=F(h)+F(k)$.
